guide.details.title: Details
guide.image.brush.name: The brush
guide.image.brush.text: When the brush is available, choose one of its three widths. A magnifier follows the brush while you draw. Keep the mark close to the area you want to change.
guide.image.generateOrEdit.name: Generate or Edit
guide.image.generateOrEdit.text: Generate creates an image from your prompt. If Edit is available, add a reference image or choose Edit below a generated image.
guide.image.look.name: Look
guide.image.look.text: If this model offers Look, choose an option to add style instructions to your prompt.
guide.image.markRegion.name: Mark a region
guide.image.markRegion.text: If the model supports region edits, paint the area to change. Fill it in instead of outlining it.
guide.image.rewrite.name: Rewrite
guide.image.rewrite.text: If Rewrite is available, it expands your prompt and each marked area's instructions. Results return to their fields before Look applies. In a batch, each row uses its own reference image.
guide.image.runCancel.name: Run and Cancel
guide.image.runCancel.text: Run empties the form it sent. Cancel puts all of it back, the marked region included.
guide.image.strip.name: The gallery
guide.image.strip.text: Use the gallery to browse your images. Download images you want to keep before clearing it.
guide.image.wait.name: The wait
guide.image.wait.text: An edit can spend about a minute reading your prompt and images before its first step. The status bar shows this time.
guide.image.whatChanges.name: What to change
guide.image.whatChanges.text: For region edits, describe each marked color separately. If available, the Mark a region template can replace these instructions.
guide.music.editScore.name: Edit score
guide.music.editScore.text: Edit the score while viewing the sheet music. Generate then creates a new version from your edited score.
guide.music.planning.name: Planning
guide.music.planning.text: Melody and chords writes a score before generating audio. Direct generation skips this step and does not provide a usable score.
guide.music.recording.name: Reference recording
guide.music.recording.text: With a recording, Generate creates a cover song. Create score turns the recording into a score.
guide.music.songsStrip.name: The gallery
guide.music.songsStrip.text: Download all saves every song as a file. Clear all removes them from this browser.
guide.music.style.name: Music style
guide.music.style.text: Describe the language, genre, mood, instruments, vocals and tempo. Add more detail than a genre name alone.
guide.music.wait.name: The wait
guide.music.wait.text: Music can take longer to generate than an image. The preview shows elapsed time. Cancel keeps completed songs.
guide.music.words.name: The words
guide.music.words.text: Use section tags to mark each part. For instrumental music, leave lyrics empty and turn on Instrumental.
guide.sheet.title: How to use
guide.start.title: Start here
guide.steps.image.look.name: Choose an optional Look
guide.steps.image.look.text: If Look is available, choose a style or leave it empty.
guide.steps.image.runBar.name: Generate, then check the result
guide.steps.image.runBar.text: Open Details to see the model, random seed and generation time. Generate clears the submitted form; Cancel restores it.
guide.steps.image.say.name: Describe your image
guide.steps.image.say.text: Describe the subject, setting and lighting. Choose Generate, then inspect the result before making changes.
guide.steps.music.listen.name: Listen, then change one thing
guide.steps.music.listen.text: Edit the score, reuse the music style, or cover a recording. Change one thing per version to compare the results.
guide.steps.music.oneTake.name: Generate one take
guide.steps.music.oneTake.text: Use the first version to check your music style. Try another random seed to see how much the result varies.
guide.steps.music.styleWords.name: Write a music style and lyrics
guide.steps.music.styleWords.text: Describe the genre, instruments and tempo in Music style. Enter the words to sing in Lyrics.
guide.steps.video.addClip.name: Add a clip for editing
guide.steps.video.addClip.text: Generate starts from a prompt. To edit an existing clip, select it and choose an effect.
guide.steps.video.addStill.name: Add an optional image or audio track
guide.steps.video.addStill.text: If supported, add reference images or an audio track to guide the video.
guide.steps.video.describe.name: Describe the shot
guide.steps.video.describe.text: Describe the subject, action, camera and lighting. Choose a template for a starting prompt.
guide.steps.video.generateScrub.name: Generate, then preview
guide.steps.video.generateScrub.text: Wait for the whole clip to finish before playback. Cancel stops the current run and keeps previously completed clips.
guide.steps.voice.play.name: Generate, then play
guide.steps.voice.play.text: The preview and gallery keep each version. Download all saves every version in one action.
guide.steps.voice.script.name: Enter the text to read
guide.steps.voice.script.text: Enter the words to speak. If supported, add cues such as [whispers] directly in the text.
guide.steps.voice.voice.name: Set the voice
guide.steps.voice.voice.text: Use Design, where available, to describe a voice. Use Clone to copy a voice from a clean recording of one speaker.
guide.video.durationSize.name: Duration and size
guide.video.durationSize.text: Choose the output shape, resolution and duration before generating. Larger or longer clips take more time and memory.
guide.video.fastMode.name: Fast mode
guide.video.fastMode.text: LTX-2.5 offers Fast mode in Advanced. It uses float16 computation with the same weights for faster rendering; generated details may differ.
guide.video.gallery.name: The gallery
guide.video.gallery.noEdit.text: Select a clip to preview it. Use the action buttons to download it, reuse its inputs or remove it.
guide.video.gallery.text: Select a clip to preview it. Use the action buttons to download, reuse inputs, edit or remove it.
guide.video.generate.name: Generate
guide.video.generate.text: Generate video from a prompt. If supported, add image keyframes or an audio track.
guide.video.generateOrEdit.name: Generate or Edit
guide.video.generateOrEdit.text: Generate video from a prompt, with optional image keyframes or audio. Edit requires a selected clip and effect. Previewing a gallery clip does not select it for editing.
guide.video.promptTemplates.name: Prompt and templates
guide.video.promptTemplates.text: Describe the subject, action, setting and camera movement. Templates provide starting points; a Look adds to your words.
guide.video.references.name: Reference images and audio
guide.video.references.text: Available references depend on the model. If supported, add image keyframes or audio to guide generation. Remove deletes only the selected reference, not saved results. In Generate, Reference adds the current frame when image references are supported.
guide.video.rewriteEnhancement.name: Rewrite and enhancement
guide.video.rewriteEnhancement.text: Where available, use Rewrite to expand your prompt. Models with automatic prompt enhancement also apply it when you generate.
guide.video.runCancel.name: Run and Cancel
guide.video.runCancel.text: Progress covers the entire run. A clip is complete when it is ready to play. Cancel stops the current run.
guide.voice.clipActions.download.text: Download saves the selected audio. More lets you use it in Video or Clone, or reuse its settings.
guide.voice.clipActions.edit.text: Edit prepares the selected audio for editing. Download saves the selected audio. More offers Video, Clone, and reuse options.
guide.voice.clipActions.name: Clip actions
guide.voice.clone.design.text: Add a clean recording of one speaker. AuK can clone the voice without a transcript. Remove this reference before recording another.
guide.voice.clone.drama.text: Add a clean recording and its exact transcript. For recordings longer than 15 seconds, only the first 15 seconds are used. Match the transcript to that excerpt.
guide.voice.clone.name: Clone a voice
guide.voice.duration.name: Duration
guide.voice.duration.text: Use automatic duration or set a target in Advanced. A target that is too short may cut off words.
guide.voice.generate.name: Generate speech
guide.voice.generate.text: Enter the text to read aloud. Generate creates one continuous audio clip from that text.
guide.voice.preview.name: Preview and selection
guide.voice.preview.text: Click the waveform to set playback position. Drag the end handles to select a range, then play it. Playback speed affects this preview only.
guide.voice.runCancel.name: Run and Cancel
guide.voice.runCancel.text: The preview and gallery show generation progress. Cancel keeps completed clips; successful generation clears the submitted inputs.
guide.voice.sharedStatus.name: Shared status
guide.voice.sharedStatus.text: Only one model can run at a time. Other tabs and API requests share that limit.
guide.voice.templates.design.text: In Design, choose a voice template or describe the voice. Enter spoken words in Text to read and delivery instructions in Voice description.
guide.voice.templates.drama.text: Choose a delivery template or add cues such as [whispers] to Text to read. Drama-3 has no separate Voice description.
guide.voice.templates.name: Templates and delivery
guide.voice.tokenLimit.name: Audio token limit
guide.voice.tokenLimit.text: Advanced sets a safety limit for each section of text. Higher limits allow longer output but may prolong repetition; the default is 2048. Generation fails if the limit is reached before completion.
